method: SASS-only fixed-window load/store register pairing; no CUDA-source ordering used
parser_limits: Register occurrence and load-to-store pairing are exact textual SASS facts.
First redefinition expands IMMA destinations to four registers, LDSM.16.M88.2 to two, and .64/.128 destinations to two/four.
The parser does not claim a dynamic latency or scoreboard-wait duration from static control fields.
Downstream shared-memory values are not assigned the identity of their prior global-load register after STS; that value identity ends at publication.

findings.binary_conclusion: llama places panel1 LDG near the phase0 tail and recycles its scattered destination registers after STS; the candidate loads panel1 before its initial combined barrier into a mostly contiguous high register bank and retains it across nearly the complete phase0 body

expressible_now: AFTER carries graph dependencies while present
BARRIER emits an actual backend barrier and enforces shared publication
REG placeholders preserve values until their consumers
not_proven_expressible_now: a hard, zero-runtime-instruction final-machine-order constraint that prevents an independent LDG from being hoisted before a selected arithmetic token
a two-sided LDG placement window that survives symbolic lowering, C/PTX rendering, and downstream ptxas scheduling
evidence: C-style and PTX renderers alias AFTER to its first source and emit no instruction
GROUP is skipped by those renderers
the optional list scheduler treats AFTER and GROUP as structural only if they survive into its input list
two Gate7 UOp dependency spellings changed source SHA but produced the identical fc11face14a8df4ff5f193110679d7cbd834567bcb0a0d0aa7fb2411ffe52df8 cubin and identical 1827-instruction rejected span

next_gate.primitive: strict_after(value, dependency), represented as a non-droppable backend-neutral scheduling edge distinct from ordinary AFTER
next_gate.semantics: return value unchanged; require final emitted load/use order after dependency; carry no CTA synchronization or memory-value semantics; a backend must lower the constraint or reject compilation rather than silently erase it
microtest_hard_gates: the constrained LDG ordinal is strictly after the lower sentinel and before its STS consumer
constrained and unconstrained controls produce different machine ordering
exactly one intended LDG and one intended STS; no added global/shared traffic
no hardware BAR, stack, local load, or local store is introduced
full_q6_hard_gates: first panel1 LDG after the initial combined barrier and before the overwrite barrier
instruction total <=5144, registers <=255, stack/local/LDL/STL all zero
trusted exactness and partial/final uint32 identity
locked same-process alternating R31: main and total paired median <=-3 us with >=24/31 wins

limitations: Static SASS proves program order and register liveness, not dynamic LDG completion latency, scoreboard stall duration, or achieved overlap.
The global-load register identity ends at STS; downstream shared LDS and IMMA dependencies cannot be assigned that same physical-register identity.
No claim is made about the exact pass that neutralized Gate7 ordering; only the identical final cubin is proven.
LDSM/IMMA direct-use classification is textual SASS operand identity; implicit hardware operand-group semantics are not used to invent a dependency.
